precision_tiers.note: WALKER ORDER NOT DECLARED SHUFFLED -- a prefix may be a biased sub-ensemble

acquisition.note: temporal band set by max OGSE period / min delta

walk.step_rule: MCMRSimulator's default TimeStep: the maximum step is the smallest of its six criteria, here the tortuosity criterion of the strand's own mesh (3.3 to 44.6 us across the strands, per strand in provenance.walk.max_timestep_ms); every step is then shortened to land exactly on every save time and on the four Pulseq rows' gradient corners and ADC times; Gaussian displacement sqrt(2 D dt) per axis; specular reflection at kappa = 0, surface relaxation off (rho = 0)
walk.seeding: per strand k: Random.seed!(3000 + k) immediately before Snapshot(positions; ...), which draws each spin's own FixedXoshiro state from the global RNG in start-list order; a strand's walk depends only on that seed (verified: the same strand run alone and four-at-a-time is byte-identical)
walk.recording: one readout(snapshot, simulation, times; return_snapshot=true) per strand at the union of the 2,715 save times and the four rows' ADC times, the four Pulseq PGSE rows in the same Simulation, so the positions and MCMRSimulator's own signal come from one walk; positions float64 um -> float32 m
walk.strand_split: kappa = 0: an intra-axonal spin never leaves its strand's inner surface, so the pool is walked one strand at a time, each strand's inner mesh alone with its own spins (the same split as figures/mesh_xengine/run_strands.jl); the 176 strands with inner-mesh index k < 184 (strand_00000..strand_00183, sorted file order) that hold spins, 40,678 spins; walkers ordered by strand, then by row of the start list
walk.hardware: Arm Neoverse-V2 CPU (72-core host, NVIDIA Grace), 8 Julia threads, nice 19
walk.spin_index_of_walker: the row of each walker in the start list is spin_index in <prefix>_walkers.csv

provenance.source_license: CC-BY-4.0 (the CACTUS pack paper/mesh/cactus's own `license` field, copied)

citation: Villarreal-Haro et al. 2023, CACTUS (https://github.com/Juanitovh/CACTUS); walk: Cottaar M. et al. (2026) MCMRSimulator.jl, MCMRSimulator.jl 1.1.0

positions.note: the 40,678 intra-axonal start positions of the 176 strands, um, in walker order (strand, then row of all_start_um.csv, the start list the CACTUS pack paper/mesh/cactus r1 of 2026-09-13 walked from)

substrate.description: CACTUS bundle: 344 strands, each an inner (axon) and outer (myelin) surface, in a periodic cell; this record: the intra-axonal pool of the 176 strands with inner-mesh index < 184, 40,678 spins from a cited start list, walked by MCMRSimulator.jl

transformations: periodic cell side read from optimized_final.txt
substrate frame from the 366 strand chords of optimized_final.txt in 1 bundle(s), z the largest bundle's mean axis
dropped 22 strand(s) with a non-watertight surface: [6, 7, 44, 52, 56, 59, 71, 179]
periodic cell centred on the origin (surfaces have negative coordinates)
inside inner = intra (1), inner..outer = myelin (2), outside outer = extra (0)
nominal pool values from the catalogued white matter
pool 'myelin' susceptibility replaced: Susceptibility(chi_iso=-1e-07, chi_aniso=-1e-07, director='radial', file=None) -> None (SubstrateSpec.replace)
provenance.meshes_walked: the 176 CACTUS bundle_00000 inner (axon) surfaces strand_XXXXX_inner_erode_0.ply (micrometres) of the strands walked, read from figures/mesh_xengine's copy (packs/mesh_pilot/cactus_repaired_ply); every one is byte-identical to the source file the spec's wall cites (sha256 checked, 176 of 176): the copy's flap repair touched only meshes no walked spin lies in
